title: Stable line claim says 2.2
reality: Current stable is v2.3.3 (changelog 2.3.3 'Synchronized the stable release identity as v2.3.3'); v2.3.0–2.3.3 have shipped since the skill's sync.
fix: In 'Honesty about the engine's limits', change 'on its 2.2 stable line' to 'on its 2.3 stable line (2.3.3 current)' and re-verify each listed limit against 2.3.x.

title: Reference table still says 22 built-in agents
reality: v2.3.0 moved optional agents into downloadable packages; fresh installs contain NO optional agents; there is a canonical 29-package official catalog (Writer/Tracker/Misc/Maps/Calls/Conversation-games) installed via Agents → Download Agents; base Engine dropped 25,000+ lines of agent/map/call/game code.
fix: In the 'When to consult bundled references' table row for agents, replace 'the 22 built-ins' with wording like 'the official downloadable agent catalog (29 packages via Agents → Download Agents; fresh installs ship with none installed), custom agents, phases, overriding agent prompts'. Also update references/agents.md accordingly (separate slice).

title: 'No plugin marketplace yet' limit is now wrong
reality: v2.3.0 added the Agents → Download Agents full-page library installing official capability packages from the Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents repo (29 individually verified packages, Install All/Uninstall All, auto-update at startup per 2.3.1, per-major compatibility catalog lanes per 2.3.3 #3712). CSS/JS client extensions and themes are still manually installed — there is no third-party marketplace for those.
fix: Rewrite the limits bullet: 'No third-party marketplace for client extensions — CSS/JS extensions/themes are still installed manually. However, official agents/feature packages ARE distributed through the in-app Agents → Download Agents catalog (29 verified packages from Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents), with auto-update and compatibility lanes.'

title: Decision hierarchy lacks 'check the official agent catalog first' step
reality: v2.3.0 published 29 first-party downloadable packages (Writer, Tracker, Misc, Maps, Calls, Conversation games — e.g. Card Evolution as Writer Agent, Hierarchical Maps as Tracker Agent, Music DJ, Lorebook Keeper, Illustrator); Professor Mari has the full catalog summary and can recommend packages.
fix: In SKILL.md's 'Decision hierarchy (internalize this)', insert a step before the custom-agent/custom-tool steps: 'Does an official downloadable agent package already do this? Check Agents → Download Agents (29-package catalog) before building a custom agent or tool — e.g. Hierarchical Maps, Music DJ, Illustrator, Calls, Card Evolution, Lorebook Keeper.'

title: Fresh installs ship with no optional agents — ideation advice must include install step
reality: v2.3.0: 'Fresh installs now contain no optional agents'; Illustrator, Maps, Calls, Music DJ, table games etc. must be installed from Download Agents before their settings, commands (/illustrate, /selfie), and Gallery actions appear; empty setup-wizard Agents steps link to Download Agents.
fix: Add a note in Mode A (near the 'Identify relevant surfaces' step or Calibration notes): when a recommendation depends on an optional agent (image/selfie generation, Maps, Calls, Music DJ, games), tell the user to install the package from Agents → Download Agents first — on a fresh 2.3.x install none of these are present and their UI/commands are hidden until installed.

title: Marinara-Agents repo is a new contribution surface not covered by contributor mode
reality: v2.3.0: first-party downloadable agents live in the separate Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents repository with its own contribution rules, issue and PR templates, catalog validation, protected review flow, and automatic CodeRabbit review; v2.3.2 added capability API 1.3 host services for packages.
fix: In Mode B, add a short subsection: work on official agent packages (Maps, Calls, games, Writer/Tracker/Misc agents) targets github.com/Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents, not Marinara-Engine — it has its own templates, catalog validation, and CodeRabbit review; scope-check (Section 0) should point to that repo's issue tracker for package work. Engine PR rules (staging branch, pnpm check, version:sync) apply only to the Engine repo.

title: Calls rename and packaging not reflected in reference-table row
reality: v2.3.2 #3676 renamed user-facing 'Conversation Calls' to 'Calls'; v2.3.0 made Calls a downloadable package and made Local Whisper a Calls-owned download (Local Speech Model controls appear only while the Calls package is installed; uninstalling removes downloaded Whisper models).
fix: In the reference table row 'Conversation audio/video calls, character video presence...', rename to 'Calls (audio/video, a downloadable package)' and note Local Whisper models are owned by the Calls package.

title: New env vars missing from contributor doc-touch knowledge
reality: v2.3.3 #3730 added CHAT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS (timeout for slow Conversation/Roleplay/Game providers) and AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED=false (persistent launcher update opt-out on Windows/macOS/Linux/Termux without disabling manual updates), documented via docs/CONFIGURATION.md.
fix: Where SKILL.md lists docs/CONFIGURATION.md ('env vars, ports, HTTPS, launcher behavior'), or in a config-facts note, add CHAT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS and AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED as known 2.3.3 env vars so troubleshooting advice reaches for them.

title: Stale 2.2 version examples in fetch-triggers and version facts
reality: Current stable is 2.3.3; Android versionName 2.3.3 with versionCode 38 (2.3.3 Changed), so any new APK's versionCode must exceed 38.
fix: Update the example phrases 'does feature X exist in 2.2 yet?' (Calibration notes) and 'does 2.2.x have feature X yet?' (When you don't know) to 2.3.x; in the Version drift section's Android rule, optionally note current stable is 2.3.3 / versionCode 38 as the monotonic floor.

title: Professor Mari in-app shortcut note outdated on About Me and catalog awareness
reality: v2.3.2 moved Conversation About Me drafting from per-editor AI Write controls to Professor Mari (she inspects a saved character/persona, writes the bio in their voice, saves directly to About Me); v2.3.0 gave Mari the canonical 29-package catalog summary so she can compare and recommend every package.
fix: Extend the 'In-app shortcut' callout: as of 2.3, Mari also drafts Conversation About Me bios (the separate AI Write controls are gone) and can recommend/compare the 29 official downloadable agent packages.

title: Game mode entry missing Tactical Combat preference
reality: v2.3.0 added a Combat Preference to Game mode, chosen in the setup wizard and changeable in Chat Settings → Combat Style: classic narrative combat, or tactical grid battles (terrain-painted battlefield, unit classes, movement/attack ranges, counters, crits, enemy phase, deterministic seeded engine, four difficulty levels).
fix: In 'First: which chat mode?' under Game, add: 'Game mode (v2.3) also offers a Combat Preference — classic narrative combat or a tactical grid-battle style (seeded deterministic engine, four difficulties) — picked in the setup wizard or later under Chat Settings → Combat Style.' Optionally note v2.3.2 reusable Game setup export/import (.marinara-game-setup.json bundles, #3701).

title: Q5 (custom agent) should route through the official downloadable-agent catalog first
reality: v2.3.0: 29 official packages cover common per-turn jobs (Card Evolution = Writer, Hierarchical Maps = Tracker, Music DJ, Lorebook Keeper, Illustrator, etc.), installed via Agents → Download Agents with auto-update (2.3.1); v2.3.2 #3692 lets selected custom agents run in Conversation, Roleplay, and Game whenever Enable Agents is on.
fix: In Q5, before recommending a custom agent, add: 'First check Agents → Download Agents — an official package (Writer/Tracker/Misc, e.g. Card Evolution, Hierarchical Maps, Music DJ) may already do the job with zero build cost. Build a custom agent only when no catalog package fits.' Also note custom agents now run in Conversation/Roleplay/Game under the per-chat Enable Agents master toggle.

title: Q8 media generation ignores the Illustrator package requirement and renames
reality: v2.3.0: Gallery Illustrate, Selfie, Storyboard, Video, Animate, and Background actions require the Illustrator package to be installed and enabled for that chat in every mode; /illustrate and /selfie commands and image/video generation settings are hidden until Illustrator is installed; Game setup's 'Visual Generation' was renamed to Illustrator; Connections' 'Illustrator' defaults category was renamed 'Images'; Conversation selfie configuration is now 'Illustrator Settings' in Chat Settings → Agents. v2.3.2 also added Venice.ai as an Image Generation service (#3682).
fix: Update Q8: still 'native connection, not a webhook', but add that all generation surfaces require the downloadable Illustrator package installed and enabled for the chat; use current names (Illustrator Settings, Connections → Images defaults). Also note the Conversation-call video presence bullet requires the downloadable Calls package.

title: Q6 claim 'server-side changes require forking' now oversimplified
reality: v2.3.2 added capability API 1.3 host services for downloadable packages (model routing, persistence, history/checkpoints, resources, logging, transactions, client contribution loading); packages own server runtimes and client surfaces, and package contributions go through the Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents repo's reviewed catalog (v2.3.0).
fix: In Q6's 'Doesn't fit', soften 'Those require forking the engine' to: server-side capability now also ships as downloadable packages via the official Marinara-Agents catalog (capability API 1.3) — contributing a package there is the reviewed path; forking is only needed for changes the capability API can't express. Client CSS/JS extensions remain the local no-review path for UI-only changes.

title: Noodle mode entry missing v2.3 controls
reality: v2.3.0 added an editable Noodle Prompt (full-screen editor, one-click default restore) at the top of Noodle Settings, and a default-on setting excluding Professor Mari from account discovery/generated activity (#3598); v2.3.2 gave world/lore context and chat carryover 8,192-token budgets.
fix: In the Noodle mode bullet, append: 'v2.3 adds an editable Noodle Prompt in Noodle Settings (customize the timeline's system instructions) and a default-on toggle excluding Professor Mari from the timeline.'

fix: Verify against the repo (it may predate 2.3), then add a Visual Novel bullet to the mode list describing when to pick it; if it exists in references/architecture.md, mirror that wording.
